title: Search result snippets with the matched phrase highlighted in context
roadmap_anchor: Q2 > Retrieval, before intelligence > Search result snippets
acceptance: Each result shows surrounding context with the matched phrase highlighted
Snippet extraction does not load full searchText for every row
Multiple matches in one post pick the most representative snippet
notes: Retrieval before intelligence — this ships before any embedding work.

history.detail: criterion 1 unmet in the default cards style; touches widened to include PostCard.swift (planning error, PostCard was omitted)

code-review found the most-representative ranking is dead code (all scores tie on whole-phrase matches) — criterion 3 unmet; plus unsqueezed text vs squeezed phrase, and a stale-snippet frame in PostRow

code-review claimed SnippetRequest must be Hashable for .task(id:) and would not compile. Disproven: SwiftUI's task(id:) is constrained to Equatable per the SDK swiftinterface, and the gate builds the app. Finding rejected.
